snippet.title: Season 4: Heroes of Busan Official Trailer | Overwatch
snippet.description:
Let your teamwork do all the talking during Season 4: Heroes of Busan.

The leader of MEKA Squad is ready for her highly anticipated debut as our newest Tank Hero, D.Mon! Take the fight straight to Talon and the Junkers with her close range Plasma Saber and protective Power Barrier.

D.Mon isn’t the only MEKA Squad pilot showing up this season. During our Shooting Star: My MEKA Mania Event, you’ll get a chance to support your favorite MEKA pilot by completing challenges, earning rewards, and seeing which one is the most popular of them all.

Battle Passes are getting revamped this season by letting you choose which track to unlock rewards in first, and by letting you swap an eligible Legendary reward for something in the curated Swap Pool.

Competitive is also getting updated with the all-new Emerald Rank, Comp Rank Reset, and the arrival of Team Drives that reward you for teaming up and sticking together as a group.

And that’s just the beginning! Look out for brand new map reworks, Mythics, the return of a fan-favorite collab, and so much more.

It all starts when Season 4: Heroes of Busan launches in-game tomorrow at 11am PT.

Overwatch is free to play on PC and console, including Nintendo Switch™ 2!
_

snippet.title: Ted Lasso — Season 4 Official Trailer (Trust the Process) | Apple TV
snippet.description:
From executive producers Bill Lawrence Jason Sudeikis, Ted Lasso follows an American football coach hired to manage a British soccer team - despite having no experience. https://apple.co/_TedLasso

Season four marks the return of fan favorites including Emmy Award winner Hannah Waddingham, Juno Temple, Emmy Award winner Brett Goldstein, Brendan Hunt and Jeremy Swift, alongside new additions Tanya Reynolds, Jude Mack, Faye Marsay, Rex Hayes, Aisling Sharkey, Abbie Hern and Grant Feely.

In season four, Ted returns to Richmond, taking on his biggest challenge yet: coaching a second division women’s football team. Throughout the course of the season, Ted and the team learn to leap before they look, taking chances they never thought they would.

“Ted Lasso” season four adds Emmy Award winner Jack Burditt (“Nobody Wants This,” “Modern Family,” “30 Rock”) as executive producer under a new overall deal with Apple TV. Sudeikis stars and executive produces alongside Hunt, Joe Kelly, Jane Becker, Jamie Lee and Bill Wrubel. Goldstein serves as writer and executive producer alongside Leann Bowen. Sarah Walker and Phoebe Walsh will serve as writers and producers for season four, and Sasha Garron co-produces. Julia Lindon will write for season four, and Dylan Marron will serve as story editor. snippet.description:
The Steel Creek Dam is under siege.

Trapped between a ruthless Riker occupation and an approaching hurricane, Division agents must reclaim the facility and prevent a catastrophic flood before it's too late.

Take on Broken Rain, a brand-new Incursion for The Division 2. Designed as the ultimate 4-player challenge, this high-skill PvE endgame experience will push your gear, strategy, coordination, and teamwork to their limits.

Face powerful new bosses, explore a new location, and earn exclusive rewards as you race to save Steel Creek Dam before disaster strikes.

Available August 11
Free for all The Division 2 owners

Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC, and in the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York.

snippet.title: The Uprising: Another Boring Grey Medieval Movie
snippet.description:
The Uprising trailer is out! Starring Andrew Garfield, it's... it's so grey. It's a grey, dull, desaturated vision of a grim Medieval hellscape that never existed.
Except the events being shown in the film did exist. The people in it lived and breathed. They went to church, celebrated birthdays, sang, danced, ate, and made handcrafts.

Are we bored of bland, grey Medieval movies yet? Have we had enough of the Medieval world being shown at 10% colour saturation?

I am. And I'm gonna rant about it.

snippet.title: Waterparks: TELL ME WHY (WE MADE THIS VIDEO TO CONVINCE MARK HOPPUS TO FEATURE ON OUR SONG)
snippet.description:
"TELL ME WHY" by Waterparks featuring Mark Hoppus, Dillon Francis, Eric Nally, and Danny Elfman, from the new album JINX

Shot by Awsten Knight
Edited by Lucas Hand

(Text +1 (858) 544-6368 for more)

►Twitter:   / waterparks
►Facebook:   / waterparks
►Instagram:   / waterparks

"TELL ME WHY"

If the only point of life is not to die
Can you tell me why
Can you tell me why? 
If the only point of life is not to die
Can you tell me why
Can you tell me why? 

I woke up in a conference room 
Two guys in polyester suits 
With clipboards say,
“We’re here to do
Your earthly exit interview!
Before we even get to that
The question that they always ask
Is ‘Can you tell me how I died?’”
“And yes, we can! Mark, hit the lights!”
“You’re waiting at the DMV
Ticket number 103
You hate the lady
Next to you
She was coughing, breathing
Next to you
“You said, ‘God please kill me now’
We decide to help you out,
Now you are here and here is now,”
“Wait—why the fuck is he freaking out?”

If the only point of life is not to die
Can you tell me why
Can you tell me why? 
If the only point of life is not to die
Can you tell me why
Can you tell me why?

My child, my child
I heard you had some questions
‘Bout policy and usage of
Divine intervention
I know that you’re frustrated 
My design is complicated 
But I’m here to answer questions if you want

Okay!
I just need some answers
Like, why do kids get cancer?
Why is murder even possible?
Why’s heartbreak feel unstoppable? 
What’s the point of allergies?
Why did you even make disease?
Why is money not fulfilling?
Why do—

If the only point of life is not to die
Can you tell me why
Can you tell me why?
If the only point of life is not to die
Can you tell me why
Can you tell me why?
Why I care
Why I cry
Why I’m so terrified
Why the hell
Do I try
Like, can I get a sign? 
If the only point of life is not to die
Can you tell me why
Can you tell me why? 

Okay, I hear you and I get it 
But to understand the answers to these questions
There’s something else you need to see.
Step into this elevator
Buh-bye—

Welcome to hell
We’re so glad you’ve arrived
Some folks that you know are already inside!
There’s nowhere to run
There’s nowhere to hide
There’s no escaping, I’ve already tried
Good luck!

*GOING DOWN*

Welcome, Mr. Knight! 
It’s a hot one, am I right? 
Uhhh, yeah, I guess, I’m just confused, like
Why am I here? What’d I do? 

Hell of a question,
Mr. Sneaking Out Of Heaven
Oooooo, deadly sins, let’s see,
You collected all seven!
And you think that you deserve an answer why
When this is how you lived your fucking life:
You treated people like possessions,
While withholding your affections, 
Thought fame would heal depression,
But you hated your reflection
And you’re just like, a bitch sometimes—wait what

Sir, it seems like there’s been a mistake 
God dammit, Janine, I really liked him

I’m sent back to that conference room,
Mark says, “We got news for you!
We got it wrong, you’re going back 
You survived the heart attack!”

Woke up to fluorescent lights,
IV’s keeping me alive
Doesn’t change the way I felt 
Saw it all and I still can’t tell

If the only point of life is not to die
Can you tell me why
Can you tell me why?
If the only point of life is not to die
Can you tell me why
Can you tell me why?

Check it out on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4210580/Ore_Factory_Squad/

More about Ore Factory Squad (from Steam):

Ore Factory Squad is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Start from a small warehouse, buy properties, dig deep for resources, process what you extract, and turn it into profit. Expand step by step and turn a simple setup into a fully functioning factory.

Play solo or with up to 4 players, running the entire operation yourself or working together to build it faster!

Procedural Mining at Its Core
Every property features procedurally generated underground resources with no fixed paths, allowing you to dig freely and shape your own tunnels.

Start with a shovel, move on to pickaxes for tougher layers, use jackhammers to speed things up, and clear large sections with dynamite. As you go deeper, resources become more valuable, making each decision more important.

From Warehouse to Industrial Production
Your factory starts with simple machines and basic resources, then expands as you unlock new machines and recipes through progression and licenses.

Handle logistics with pallets and forklifts, connect your machines with conveyor belts to create more efficient production flows, gradually turning your warehouse into a larger and more capable industrial system.

Buy Properties, Dig for Profit
Purchase different types of properties, each featuring randomized resource distribution and profit potential.
From small backyards to big construction sites, forest areas, and large quarries on snowy mountains, each location offers a different environment and opportunities.
Dig, extract, process, and turn every property into profit as you grow into larger and more valuable operations.

Contracts, Sales, and Growth
Take on contracts from companies requesting specific products and quantities, negotiate deals, prepare deliveries, and load trucks to fulfill orders for higher rewards.
Manage your stock, use smart warehouse robots, organize shipments, and balance your growth with fast stock sales.

Tools, Upgrades, and Equipment
Begin with simple tools and unlock and upgrade more powerful mining equipment as you progress.

Upgrade your factory to expand your operation, increase your market reach, take on more contracts, improve negotiation rates, hire and manage workers, and gain licenses that unlock new machines and production lines.

Customize your character with different outfits, faces, gloves, and helmets, and personalize your factory with walls, floors, signs, and decorations.

Build Solo or Scale Together
Run everything yourself or work together as a team. Take full control and progress at your own pace, or split the work, optimize production, and grow faster together.

Core Features:
Procedurally generated underground with fully diggable terrain and no fixed mining paths
Unlockable and upgradeable mining equipment including shovel, pickaxe, jackhammer, and explosives
Property system with multiple types, each featuring randomized ore distribution and profit potential
Multi-stage production system with machines enabling different processing outputs
Factory progression driven by machine unlocks, licenses, expanding production chains, upgrades
Conveyor-based production system with integrated factory automation, including warehouse robots
Logistics and transport using controllable vehicles such as forklifts and trucks
Contract system with production requirements, delivery preparation, loading, and negotiation mechanics
Character and factory customization
Fully playable solo or co-op with up to 4 players

More about Ore Factory Squad (from Steam):

Ore Factory Squad is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Start from a small warehouse, buy properties, dig deep for resources, process what you extract, and turn it into profit. Expand step by step and turn a simple setup into a fully functioning factory.

Play solo or with up to 4 players, running the entire operation yourself or working together to build it faster!

Procedural Mining at Its Core
Every property features procedurally generated underground resources with no fixed paths, allowing you to dig freely and shape your own tunnels.

Start with a shovel, move on to pickaxes for tougher layers, use jackhammers to speed things up, and clear large sections with dynamite. As you go deeper, resources become more valuable, making each decision more important.

From Warehouse to Industrial Production
Your factory starts with simple machines and basic resources, then expands as you unlock new machines and recipes through progression and licenses.

Handle logistics with pallets and forklifts, connect your machines with conveyor belts to create more efficient production flows, gradually turning your warehouse into a larger and more capable industrial system.

Buy Properties, Dig for Profit
Purchase different types of properties, each featuring randomized resource distribution and profit potential.
From small backyards to big construction sites, forest areas, and large quarries on snowy mountains, each location offers a different environment and opportunities.
Dig, extract, process, and turn every property into profit as you grow into larger and more valuable operations.

Contracts, Sales, and Growth
Take on contracts from companies requesting specific products and quantities, negotiate deals, prepare deliveries, and load trucks to fulfill orders for higher rewards.
Manage your stock, use smart warehouse robots, organize shipments, and balance your growth with fast stock sales.

Tools, Upgrades, and Equipment
Begin with simple tools and unlock and upgrade more powerful mining equipment as you progress.

Upgrade your factory to expand your operation, increase your market reach, take on more contracts, improve negotiation rates, hire and manage workers, and gain licenses that unlock new machines and production lines.

Customize your character with different outfits, faces, gloves, and helmets, and personalize your factory with walls, floors, signs, and decorations.

Build Solo or Scale Together
Run everything yourself or work together as a team. Take full control and progress at your own pace, or split the work, optimize production, and grow faster together.

Core Features:
Procedurally generated underground with fully diggable terrain and no fixed mining paths
Unlockable and upgradeable mining equipment including shovel, pickaxe, jackhammer, and explosives
Property system with multiple types, each featuring randomized ore distribution and profit potential
Multi-stage production system with machines enabling different processing outputs
Factory progression driven by machine unlocks, licenses, expanding production chains, upgrades
Conveyor-based production system with integrated factory automation, including warehouse robots
Logistics and transport using controllable vehicles such as forklifts and trucks
Contract system with production requirements, delivery preparation, loading, and negotiation mechanics
Character and factory customization
Fully playable solo or co-op with up to 4 players

Info about the map written by oxygendavid
Welcome to Witcombe Park Farm
📍 Inspired by the countryside of Gloucestershire, UK

🌄 A carefully crafted blend of real‑world geography and fictional design, creating a distinctive and authentic UK farming landscape.
🚜 60+ fields ranging from small paddocks to large arable expanses.
🗺️ 100+ purchasable farmlands, including extensive forestry plots and hidden woodland corners.
🐇 New animal: Rabbits
🐖🐄🐑 New British livestock breeds, each with their own stats: • Gloucestershire Old Spot (pigs) • Hereford & Jersey (cattle) • Suffolk, Bluefaced Leicester & Texel (sheep)
🌦️ Fully reworked environment XML featuring new weather patterns, lighting profiles, cloud systems, and a refreshed daytime skybox.
🌱 Completely redesigned UK style ground textures and foliage, giving the map a fresh, grounded visual identity. 🚂 Driveable Class 40 (UK) 🇬🇧 Step into the cab of a fully driveable British Rail Class 40 and experience true UK diesel‑electric power in action! 🔧⚡
Fire up the engine, take the controls, and enjoy driving one of Britain’s most iconic locomotives right inside the game. 🚆✨ Who’s taking it for a spin first 😄
🌲 High detail forest assets for a more realistic woodland experience.
🎧 Custom ambient soundscape tailored to the map’s environment.
🚗 New UK‑style traffic, including motorbikes, tractors, and articulated lorries.
🏡 4 fully developed main farms, each with their own character.
🏘️ 4+ small holdings, offering varied and immersive starting points.
🛠️ Full customization sellable farm buildings, removable junk piles, adjustable field borders, and more.
🎮 Designed to support every playstyle  from small scale realism to large scale contracting.

Multi Terrain Angle added 
🌾 14 New Crops Added 
📦 From PfalzAgrar Multi Prefab Pack (10):
Rye • Triticale • Spelt • Grain Maize • Green Rye • Vetch Rye • Field Grass • Silage Maize • Humus Activator • Mustard

🌼 Custom Crops (3):
Alfalfa • Linseed • Poppy

🏭 7 custom production chains integrated seamlessly into the map.
🍎 4 dedicated fruit sell points
🏪 10 additional sell points for productions, materials, and goods.
🧱 30+ new UK‑themed placeables
🏘️ Hundreds of high‑detail UK assets populating the world.


Music by Epidemic Sound
